_about: The keys each app namespace may share with `common`. A variant namespace is read before `common`, so any copy of a common
string there hides later fixes to the shared string in that one app (translations.test.ts enforces this list).
Add a key only for wording that is deliberately different in that app (its UX: e.g. Responder is about the member, Unit about
the unit), with the reason. The wording overrides the legacy-app merge kept (review/en-conflicts.csv) were unified into
`common` on 2026-11-02 (owner decision); only these deliberate ones remain.
A fix to a shared string goes in `common` and the feature's i18n.en.json, never in one app's namespace.

responder.location.tracking_notification_body: Responder shares the member's own location, not a unit's

unit.settings.realtime_geolocation_warning: Unit sends the unit's location as well as receiving others'
